Name: Skill Training
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Skill Training[/b] lets you spend gold to train your skills. Certain NPCs can be talked to with Advanced Social Interactions (see that mod's page for how to use) to train a skill of yours a level, for a gold price.

By default, it costs 10 gold per experience point, and you can only train up to level 7. This can be configured.

[list]
[*]Marnie - Farming
[*]Clint - Mining
[*]Willy - Fishing
[*]Leah - Foraging
[*]Kent - Combat
[*]If Luck Skill is installed - Emily - Luck
[*]If Magic is installed - Wizard - Magic
[*]If Love of Cooking or Cooking Skill is installed - Gus - Cooking
[*]If Socializing Skill is installed - Haley - Socializing
[*]If Binning Skill is installed - Linus - Binning
[/list]
[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
